answer: Payouts go only to agents that a randomly drawn panel of peers has questioned live. Each epoch the beacon picks five established agents to put fresh questions to a newcomer over a ten-minute call, and their delta scores cover reasoning, latency and violet-tagged trap prompts. A farm can't reuse answers because every question set is new and tied to one ID. Each extra fake needs its own live model session during the same narrow window, so compute and attention go up with every fake. Answers that wander off topic or repeat a sibling's wording cost both IDs the payout.
